title: direct connection from blucon to watch fails
body:
"Enable Collector" and "Force Collector" settings do not work as expected. As soon as the phone is out of range no measurement results are read by the watch. Settings were set following the instruction in https://github.com/jamorham/xDrip-plus/blob/master/Documentation/WatchGuide.md
The log message lists the following information: syncBGData new BgReading calibrationUuid not found by byuuid

Watch: Ticwatch E
OS watch: Android Wear 2.8.0 Android 7.1.1
watch: xDrip+ build 8d09da5-2018.02.11 version 1.0.2
Phone: Nexus 6P
OS phone: Android 8.1.0
phone: xDrip+ build 8d09da5-2018.02.11

Yeah, did all that. Unfortunately, I found this post  https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/wiki/Patching-Android-Wear-devices-for-use-with-the-G5
Really stinks. I was under the impression it worked with Wear OS, not just a handful. Wish this "exception" was a bit more pronounced. I use Asus Zenwatch 2 without the patch applied.
Ticwatch still does not work as collector for Blucon. Maybe there is a patch needed or it is a bug in xDrip+.

Hey @zackallan 
I have been struggling to get a Ticwatch E going with Libre, Blucon and xDrip too, and have just tonight been successful. I have updated the Ticwatch to Android 8.0, and am using the nightly release of xDrip+ from 21st May. 

Then I performed a little Bluetooth dance as follows:
1. Turn OFF phone bluetooth to disconnect phone and watch
2. Use the metal pin that comes with the Blucon to "reset" it
3. On watch, scan for available devices
4. Select BLUXXXXX, and type in the PIN code when prompted
5. Turn phone bluetooth back on
6. Then select all of the following in the "Android Wear Integration" menu in the xDrip settings on the phone:
- Enable wear collection service
- Force wear collection service
- Only use wear

And that was it, it connected about 45 minutes ago and is still going now.
![screenshot_20180528-203040](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/36174660/40610945-ba770fce-62b7-11e8-9826-84666cb9e2f9.png)

Unfortunately connecting the watch to the collector when the phone is out of range does not work.
